Security & Trust

At Dash0, your security, privacy, and trust are our top priorities. Here, you'll find information on how we protect your data, comply with regulations, and uphold ethical standards. We are dedicated to creating a secure and reliable environment for you.

Dash0 is fully compliant with the General Data Protection Regulation of the European Union (GDPR), ensuring robust protection for your personal and sensitive information in accordance with stringent EU regulations.

Dash0 also has achieved certification for Service Organization Control 2 Type 2 (SOC2 Type 2), a gold standard in data security and operational excellence. This rigorous certification demonstrates our dedication to maintaining the highest levels of security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy for your observability data.

With Dash0, you can trust that your data is safeguarded and managed with industry-leading standards, giving you peace of mind as you harness the power of observability to drive your business forward. Our commitment to compliance and security empowers you to focus on what matters most while we handle the complexities of data protection with precision and care.

Security and Compliance Center

Dash0 uses Safebase to manage and publish the all its certifications, security, trust and legal related documents.

Go to security.dash0.com to access this information and ask questions.
